rows.title: Sphere rolls through a standing line of objects
rows.initial_state: A table sits in the scene with the floor below it. A sphere rests on the table at one end of a clear path. rows.counterfactual: The only change is that the box is moved slightly off the sphere’s path at t=0. The sphere rolls past without hitting it, so the bottle and book remain undisturbed.

A sphere sits farther along the same line, and a box stands beyond the sphere, all separated so nothing is touching at t=0.
rows.what_happens: The first slab topples forward and hits the second slab. That impact starts the second slab falling, and the second slab then hits the third slab. The third slab topples into the sphere, sending the sphere rolling across the table. The rolling sphere then strikes the box and nudges it into a short slide.
rows.counterfactual: Change only one thing: the sphere is moved slightly farther away from the third slab at t=0. Everything else stays the same. The third slab still topples, but it no longer reaches the sphere, so the final collision with the box does not happen.

rows.title: Sphere rolls into a bottle and tips a book
rows.initial_state: On the table, a book stands upright near the middle, with a bottle standing upright a short distance in front of it. A sphere rests farther back on the table in line with the bottle and book. All three bodies are separate at t=0, and the sphere is already moving toward the bottle when the clip opens.
rows.what_happens: The moving sphere rolls forward across the table, slows slightly under friction, and hits the bottle. The bottle is driven forward into the upright book. The book shifts, tips past its balance point, and falls over onto the table while the bottle wobbles and is pushed aside by the impact.
rows.counterfactual: Change only one aspect: the sphere starts farther back on the table while everything else stays the same. With the extra distance, it reaches the bottle more slowly and the bottle is not pushed hard enough to tip the book.

rows.title: Sphere rolls down ramp into a bottle and a book

The bottle is pushed sideways and topples while the sphere deflects onward. The moving sphere then hits the book, making the book slide and tip slightly as the sphere slows from the second impact.
rows.counterfactual: The only change is that the bottle is removed from the sphere’s path. The sphere still rolls down the incline, but after reaching the tabletop it reaches the book directly, so the first collision is with the book instead of the bottle.
